desc: Prove the exact correspondence between distinct orientation indegree sequences and spanning forests (acyclic edge subsets).
Derive an explicit forest-count recurrence/formula specialized to the rim cycle and selected hub spokes, handling zero and one selected spoke separately.
Reduce the recurrence to O(N) time and O(1) or small-state memory modulo 998244353.
Validate the recurrence by exhaustive enumeration on small N, including no ones, all ones, isolated ones, and adjacent runs.
